source: CUA live native interactions; isolated fixture data

passed.observed: Today column created 看板列内创建验收 with Today date; a single undo removed it and restored the column count.
Right-clicking 联调与回归 and choosing Medium changed its visible priority flag.
Card date opened the shared date dialog; Escape canceled the draft without changing the stored schedule. Date confirmation was not exercised in this manual flow.
Hide details removed metadata while preserving body preview; restoring details showed it again. Hiding and restoring Tags removed and restored actual tag text.
Abandoned showed only 取消旧计划. Restore removed it; one undo restored the abandoned task and count. Completed showed only 整理上周笔记.

passed.flow: Filter editor Inbox and draft cancellation
passed.observed: Selecting Inbox reduced the preview from 10 unfinished tasks to 收集箱对齐验收 only. Cancel did not create a filter.
Saved 收集箱过滤验收 showed the same one unfinished match. Navigating to Completed showed its completed task rather than retaining the Inbox filter.

passed.flow: Context menu parent assignment and copy link
passed.observed: The actual menu opened a focused, searchable parent picker. Confirming 完善本周方案 under 需求评审 changed child progress from 0/2 to 0/3; one undo restored 0/2. Copy Link produced a workfollow://task/ link, verified by pasting into an unsubmitted QA draft and clearing it.
The merge action was disabled with one selected item and enabled with two.
整理交付检查项 and 补充旅行计划 both became children of 需求评审. Progress changed 0/2 to 0/4; one undo restored both tasks and their original Work/Life lists.

passed.flow: Batch note conversion, undo and redo
passed.observed: Two selected tasks generated two notes. One Cmd+Z removed both notes; one Cmd+Shift+Z restored both. A final undo restored both source tasks and removed the generated notes.
Opening 收集箱过滤验收 showed the saved name as the page title and one unfinished matching task.

passed.flow: Final build kanban menu and date shortcut
passed.observed: The kanban context menu visibly included Link Parent and Copy Link. Choosing Tomorrow moved 联调与回归 out of Today into the upcoming column; one undo restored Today and the prior column counts.
